an5.143:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.143:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an5.143:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena pañcamattānaṃ Licchavisatānaṃ Sārandade cetiye sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:-- 2.
an5.143:1.6: Hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, assaratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, itthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.143:1.7: Imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin ti. 3.
an5.143:2.1: Atha kho te Licchavī magge purisaṃ ṭhapesuṃ
an5.143:2.2: ‘yathā tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi Bhagavantaṃ āgacchantaṃ, atha amhākaṃ āroceyyāsī' ti.
an5.143:2.3: Addasā kho so puriso Bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
an5.143:2.4: disvā yena te Licchavī ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te Licchavī etad avoca
an5.143:2.5: ‘ayaṃ so bhante Bhagavā āgacchati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho,
an5.143:3.1: Atha kho te Licchavī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te Licchavī Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ
an5.143:4.1: ‘sādhu bhante Bhagavā yena Sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā' ti.
an5.143:4.3: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho Bhagavā te Licchavī etad avoca
an5.143:4.4: ‘kāya nu 'ttha Licchavī etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā' ti?
an5.143:4.5: ‘Idha bhante amhākaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi
an5.143:4.8: Hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, assaratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, itthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.143:4.9: Imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin" ti. 4.
an5.143:5.1: Kāmādhimuttānaṃ vata bho Licchavīnaṃ kāmaṃ yeva ārabbha antarākathā udapādi.
an5.143:5.2: Pañcannaṃ Licchavī ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.143:5.4: Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ,
an5.143:5.5: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ,
an5.143:5.6: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ;
an5.143:5.7: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātassa dhammānudhammapaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ,
an5.143:5.9: Imesaṃ kho Licchavī pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin
